digest.component_or_area: LLM provider / OpenAI Responses API compatibility
propositions: Hosted OpenAI via openai:/openai-chat: is Responses-ready at pydantic-ai layer but blocked in rebar by four production-construction constraint sites that lack openai-responses: support or normalization
Custom base_url endpoints and per-candidate endpoint overrides are Chat-Completions-only in rebar because ProviderSession._build_openai and endpoint registration keys only support openai/openai-chat
Third-party providers (deepseek, grok, xai, groq, cerebras, moonshotai, heroku, gateway/openai) construct Chat models under pydantic-ai 1.107.2 with no Responses path available

Contract tests for openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes pass identically for structured output, streaming, tool calls, 429 retry, and custom-base-URL routing, establishing behavioral equivalence where both construction paths exist

Four named rebar code sites must be unblocked for openai-responses: to be resolvable: KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES (config.py), _pydantic_ai_known_providers (providers.py), _PROFILE_RESOLVERS (capabilities.py), and openai:/openai-chat: normalizers (anthropic_model.py and model_classes.py)
Missing evidence: xai/groq construction classes (optional extras not installed) and vendor-side /v1/responses API support (deferred until upstream pin adds third-party Responses paths)
